top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology proposal best combines a defined, mature physiological discovery with profound, durable therapeutic transformation in diabetes and obesity. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker are a defensible representation of the core discovery, provided recognition remains explicitly limited to enabling physiology rather than the entire subsequent drug-development enterprise.
